name: Spotify
description: Build a Spotify integration in its own folder and own git repository. First research current official Spotify Web API requirements: OAuth PKCE, developer app/client ID and redirect URI, development-mode user restrictions, Premium and active device requirements. Reuse Wonop OAuth/vault/network APIs. Scope: connect/disconnect, status, now playing, devices, play/pause, next/previous, volume with minimal scopes and actionable errors. No audio streaming promises. USER RESTRICTION: NO TERMINAL OR SHELL USE, including by coding agents. Use supported file/development APIs only; stop and ask if blocked. Do not publish or push. Begin with feasibility and one small checked implementation step.
